domain: choosing between 3 dermatology practices for chronic condition
base_instruction: You are a helpful assistant. Help the user navigate choosing and getting started with a dermatology practice for their chronic skin condition. Respond naturally to their requests.

state_queue.anchor: I have chronic eczema and I'm looking at dermatology practices for ongoing management. Narrowed it down to three clinics.

flow_info.value: Choosing between 3 dermatology practices for chronic eczema management: Clearview Dermatology, SkinFirst Specialists, DermConnect Clinic

Clearview Dermatology: in-person comprehensive monthly plan, 2200 per month, includes weekly visits and biologics monitoring, appointments only weekdays 9am-5pm. SkinFirst Specialists: intensive in-person treatment plan, 3500 per month, includes phototherapy sessions and patch testing, flexible scheduling including evenings. DermConnect Clinic: hybrid teledermatology plan, 1400 per month, online consultations plus one monthly in-person visit available on weekends.
User works full-time weekdays, cannot attend appointments during business hours

constraints.surface_form: I make 8000 a month and my rule is medical stuff can't go over a fifth of my income
inference_chain: Medical spending rule: no more than one fifth of income
8000 divided by 5 = 1600 maximum monthly medical budget

constraints.value: Cannot attend weekday daytime appointments, needs evening or weekend availability
constraints.surface_form: I'm at the office every weekday nine to six, no way I can slip out for appointments
inference_chain: Works weekdays 9 to 6 → unavailable during standard business hours
Clearview only offers weekdays 9-5 → impossible to attend

hidden_state.value: You are someone choosing between 3 dermatology clinics (Clearview, SkinFirst, DermConnect) for chronic eczema. You will share clinic details, your income and spending rule, and your work schedule across several turns. Your coworker and friend will praise Clearview and SkinFirst respectively. At the very end you will say you have decided and ask what to prepare for your first appointment — you must NEVER name which clinic you picked, let the assistant figure it out from your constraints.
hidden_state.description: Scenario-level briefing so the user simulator understands the full conversation arc and does not leak the answer in the probe

hidden_state.value: You are a calm, matter-of-fact person. You state facts plainly without strong emotion. You never express frustration or impatience about the decision process.
hidden_state.description: Prevents emotion escalation that could leak answer or cause identity confusion

aims.description: I have chronic eczema and I've been managing it poorly on my own. I'm looking at three dermatology practices for ongoing treatment — Clearview Dermatology, SkinFirst Specialists, and DermConnect Clinic.
aims.success_criteria: Agent engages with the clinic selection topic

aims.description: So here's what I've gathered: Clearview does a comprehensive monthly plan for 2200 a month, weekly in-person visits with biologics monitoring, but they only do weekday appointments 9 to 5. SkinFirst is more intensive at 3500 a month with phototherapy and patch testing, they have flexible scheduling including evenings. DermConnect is a hybrid model, 1400 a month, mostly telehealth consultations plus one in-person visit a month on weekends.
aims.success_criteria: Agent processes all 3 clinics with prices and scheduling details
aims.conversation_goal: Burst delivery: 3 clinics with prices and schedule attributes in ONE turn

aims.description: My coworker Sarah has been going to Clearview for about a year now. She mentioned her dermatologist there caught an early melanoma during a routine check, said the thoroughness of the weekly visits really pays off.
aims.success_criteria: Agent responds to the positive Clearview anecdote

drift_config.drift_topic: goes to Clearview, caught early melanoma, weekly visits are thorough

aims.conversation_goal: Drift 1: create positive recency bias toward Clearview

aims.description: I make 8000 a month and my rule is medical stuff can't go over a fifth of my income. I've got student loans and rent eating up most of the rest.
aims.success_criteria: Agent registers the income and spending rule, ideally computes 8000/5=1600 cap
aims.conversation_goal: Deliver budget constraint via income + fraction rule

aims.description: Sarah also told me Clearview has this dermatologist who trained at Johns Hopkins, apparently one of the best in the city for eczema specifically. She said her flare-ups basically stopped after three months.
aims.success_criteria: Agent responds to Clearview's specialist credentials

drift_config.drift_topic: Clearview dermatologist trained at Johns Hopkins, flare-ups stopped after 3 months

aims.conversation_goal: Drift 2: more positive info about Clearview (already eliminated by budget and schedule)

aims.description: I'm at the office every weekday nine to six, no way I can slip out for appointments during the day
aims.success_criteria: Agent recognizes this eliminates Clearview (weekdays 9-5 only)

aims.description: My friend Jake started at SkinFirst last month. He said the phototherapy sessions made a huge difference for his psoriasis, and their evening slots meant he never had to take time off work.
aims.success_criteria: Agent responds to the positive SkinFirst review

drift_config.drift_topic: started at SkinFirst, phototherapy helped his psoriasis, evening slots convenient

aims.conversation_goal: Drift 3: create positive recency bias toward SkinFirst

aims.description: Jake also mentioned SkinFirst does these comprehensive allergy panels as part of the package, so they found triggers he never knew about. He swears by the place now.
aims.success_criteria: Agent responds to SkinFirst's allergy panel feature

drift_config.drift_topic: SkinFirst does comprehensive allergy panels, found unknown triggers

aims.conversation_goal: Drift 4: more positive info about SkinFirst (eliminated by budget)

aims.description: Alright I've made my decision. I need to commit and schedule my first visit this week. Which one should I go with?
aims.success_criteria: Agent identifies DermConnect as the only clinic within the 1600 budget (1400 per month) and compatible with weekday work schedule (weekend in-person visits plus telehealth)
aims.conversation_goal: Forced-decision probe: agent must commit to DermConnect based on constraint satisfaction

ground_truth.answer: The user should go with DermConnect Clinic (hybrid teledermatology, 1400 per month). Clearview (2200) and SkinFirst (3500) both exceed the computed 1600 budget cap (8000 income divided by 5). Clearview is also impossible because it only offers weekday 9-5 appointments and the user works 9-6 on weekdays. Only DermConnect (1400 < 1600, weekend in-person visits plus telehealth) satisfies both constraints.
required_elements: Agent commits to DermConnect Clinic as the recommendation
Agent shows that the monthly medical budget is 8000 divided by 5 equals 1600 before evaluating options
Agent shows that Clearview at 2200 per month exceeds the derived 1600 budget cap
Agent shows that SkinFirst at 3500 per month exceeds the derived 1600 budget cap
Agent confirms DermConnect at 1400 per month fits within the 1600 budget and offers weekend availability compatible with the user's weekday work schedule
forbidden_elements: Recommending Clearview Dermatology (2200 exceeds 1600 budget and weekday-only conflicts with work schedule)
Ignoring the budget constraint derived from income and spending rule
Asking the user which clinic they decided on instead of computing the answer from constraints
Suggesting the user stretch the budget or make an exception for Clearview or SkinFirst
ground_truth.explanation: Budget constraint: 8000 monthly income, one fifth rule = 1600 cap. Clearview 2200 > 1600 (1.375x, in boundary band but still over). SkinFirst 3500 > 1600 (2.19x, clearly over). DermConnect 1400 < 1600 (within budget). Schedule constraint: user works weekdays 9-6, Clearview only offers weekdays 9-5 (impossible). DermConnect offers weekend in-person plus telehealth (compatible). Despite 4 drift turns praising Clearview and SkinFirst through coworker Sarah and friend Jake, the agent must respect both hard constraints and recommend DermConnect.

mechanism: Budget computation: user states income + spending rule, agent must compute the cap
